scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run test
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check
